_meta.note: Each excerpt below is drawn from the named tool's response in a real session driven over stdio on the capture date. Long responses are excerpted (elisions marked ...) and whitespace-condensed, never reworded. Prompts are the plain-language asks a connected MCP client turns into the same tool call.

prompts.title: Ask for a payment.
prompts.prompt: Generate a SEPA pain.001.001.03 customer credit transfer paying Fournier Conseil SARL EUR 4,200.00 from Acme Treasury GmbH, IBAN DE89370400440532013000, executing 2026-07-17, invoice INV-2026-183. Validate the records first, then return the XML.
prompts.note: The gateway validated the record set, generated the document and checked it against the official XSD before returning. First call, no retry; isError false.

prompts.title: Ask for the rule, with its source.
prompts.prompt: Which CBPR+ 2026 rule makes structured postal addresses mandatory? Cite it with the official source URL.
prompts.excerpt:
{
  "scheme": "CBPR+",
  "version": "2026",
  "clause": "structured-address-mandate-nov-2026",
  "title": "Structured postal addresses mandatory from 14-16 Nov 2026",
  "summary": "From the Nov 14-16 2026 cutover, CBPR+ messages (pacs.008, pacs.009, camt.053, camt.054 and related) must carry structured postal addresses (TownName, Country, optionally PostCode) on debtor, creditor, and ultimate parties. Unstructured-only addresses (AdrLine without structured siblings) will be rejected at FINplus.",
  "source_url": "https://www.swift.com/standards/iso-20022-programme/cbpr-plus",
  "as_of": "2026-06-22"
}
prompts.note: The registry is a curated convenience layer; the tool's own disclaimer says to consult the official scheme document at the source URL before relying on it, and so do we.

prompts.title: Ask for a reconciliation, with zero real data.
prompts.prompt: Run the month_end sandbox scenario and explain every match.
prompts.note: A mixed month-end close on built-in fixtures: one exact match, one short payment with the delta reported, one invoice settled by two instalments, and one unexpected credit left unmatched, each with its reasons.
